name: Il San Corrado di Noto Resort
positioning: Rural Sicilian resort in a former prince's residence about 20 minutes from Noto, with two pools, pool villas and a private beach club
best_for: Food-focused couples who want a quiet countryside base near Noto
Travelers who want pool time plus a shuttle to Noto and a private beach club

facts.text: Il San Corrado is about 20 minutes from Noto, in a rural setting.
The estate was once the private residence of a prince.
Architect Corrado Papa adapted the old masseria buildings for modern use, with interiors carved from Modican stone.
Sun loungers and rooms line two large pools.
The pool villas sit among the olive groves, match the suites' design and add private pools and greater privacy.
Principe di Belludia is the polished restaurant, with a window onto the kitchen.
The food concept also caters to vegetarians and vegans, and tea, herbal teas and snacks are served in the afternoon.
Spa massages and facials use chemical-free Sodashi products.
The Technogym fitness center overlooks the main pool.
There is a tennis court on the grounds among olive and citrus groves.
The hotel holds outdoor cinema evenings and yoga classes.
The hotel uses its own well and a water recycling system to water the gardens.

highlights.text: An orchid-clad library displays Helmut Newton prints.
The family's private 19th-century chapel was left untouched.
CasaPasta is a more relaxed poolside restaurant where chefs work around a large pizza oven and outdoor grill.
A complimentary shuttle runs to Noto and to the hotel's private beach club.
The hotel organizes excursions such as visiting hidden villages in the Hyblaean Mountains with a local guide, or truffle hunting.

considerations.text: The hotel is geared toward adults, particularly in the communal spaces; child-friendly areas are kept separate from adult spots.
There are no stairs in the hotel and it suits wheelchairs, but the surrounding paths are uneven.
WhataHotel notes the countryside setting means a car or private transfer is needed to explore nearby towns.
